meta.source: knowledge-base/branding-guideline/brand-guidelines.md and knowledge-base/design-system/, extended for the LinkedIn canvas.
meta.canvas: 1080 × 1350 px, LinkedIn portrait 4:5. Every size below is in canvas pixels; a phone shows the slide at about a third of that.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Seekridge Navy. The flat ground of covers, statements, figures and closes; headings and accents on paper slides. Paper on navy is 10.5:1.

tokens.name: navy-deep
tokens.usage: Darker navy from the reversed logo. Flat panels on a navy slide (layer cards, the evidence panel), always with a paper-35 hairline, because navy-deep on navy is only 1.1:1.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Paper. All text on navy; the flat ground of proof slides (screenshots, tables, charts). Navy on paper is 10.5:1.

tokens.name: paper-72
tokens.usage: Secondary line under a title on navy, captions under figures (6.3:1 on navy). One supporting style per slide; 32px or larger.

tokens.name: paper-35
tokens.usage: Hairlines, motif lines, empty squares in the slide counter and weight-bar tracks on navy. Decorative only (2.7:1): never text.

tokens.name: gold-light
tokens.usage: The gold on navy (5.2:1): up to 3 highlighted words, the gold point in a motif, the top weight in an evidence trail. A slide's one gold element.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Meridian Gold on paper: shapes only (a point, a 6px underline, the top weight bar). Never text on paper (2.75:1). A slide's one gold element.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text on paper and in white cards and frames (15.4:1 on paper).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, source lines and labels on paper (5.4:1) and in white cards (6.0:1).

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Screenshot frames and white cards, on either ground. Always with a hairline border on paper; never a shadow.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders of frames and cards on paper, skeleton bars inside mock-ups, weight-bar tracks on paper. Decorative only.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Inactive squares and outlines on paper (3.2:1). Never body text.

styles.name: title-cover
styles.usage: Cover titles and the close's action line: about 8 words, 3 lines at most, left-aligned at the 96px margin. ExtraBold throughout; never all-caps.

styles.name: title-question
styles.sample: Can you explain why this customer?
styles.usage: A centred question on hook covers and event covers. Up to 12 words, 4 lines.

styles.name: title-statement
styles.sample: A score tells you who. It rarely tells you why.
styles.usage: One claim per slide, up to about 20 words. Left-aligned, Bold, with up to 3 words in gold-light.

styles.name: title-long
styles.sample: Nicht jede Bewertung hält einer Prüfung durch die Aufsicht stand.
styles.usage: The step-down for statements of 20–30 words, typical in German and Dutch. Use it instead of narrowing the margins.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Headings on proof, list and screenshot slides; on paper slides set in navy. 2 lines at most.

styles.name: title-step
styles.sample: Ask what the score is made of
styles.usage: Item headline beside the numeral in a Field guide. 3 lines at most.

styles.name: figure-hero
styles.usage: The one number a Proof slide is about. Tabular figures, paper on navy or navy on paper, never gold. Always followed by what it measures and a source line.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Second-level figures: two-up comparisons, the count on a Field guide cover, a currency amount that won't fit at hero size.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: The item number on Field guide slides, always two digits, top-left. Tabular figures.

styles.name: body-lead
styles.sample: Seekridge shows the rate reset, the equity and the market behind each moment.
styles.usage: The one supporting paragraph under a title on navy or paper, up to 30 words. Paper-72 on navy, ink-muted or ink on paper.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Each data point carries its weight, so an advisor can say why before they call.
styles.usage: Body copy on a slide, up to 40 words.

styles.name: card-body
styles.sample: Rate fixed until March 2027; equity up 22% since purchase.
styles.usage: Text inside white cards, evidence rows and checklist rows. Ink on white.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: The title line inside a card or panel, and speaker names. SemiBold.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: The one button on an Event invite or close. SemiBold, sentence case.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Series or topic label above a heading, top-left. Set uppercase in CSS (letter-spacing 0.08em), typed in sentence case. The one all-caps element.

styles.name: data-label
styles.usage: Weights, layer tags and figures inside evidence rows and tables. Tabular figures.

styles.name: source
styles.sample: Source: backtest on a lender's 2025 book, n = 18,400
styles.usage: The source line under every figure, chart and screenshot. Paper-72 on navy, ink-muted on paper.

styles.name: counter
styles.usage: The slide counter bottom-left, beside the square strip. Tabular figures.

tokens.name: canvas-margin
tokens.usage: Safe margin on every side. Text, logo, counter and arrow sit inside it; only a motif may bleed past it.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Gap between a title and its supporting line, between columns, and between a heading and a frame.

tokens.name: gap-stack
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked cards, evidence rows and checklist rows (the design system's card gap).

tokens.name: card-padding
tokens.usage: Inner padding of white cards and navy-deep panels.

tokens.name: lockup-width
tokens.usage: Width of the lockup on covers and closes (80px tall); top-left at the margin, or centred on closes.

tokens.name: mark-size
tokens.usage: The mark, bottom-right at the margin on every slide but the cover and the close.

tokens.name: arrow-width
tokens.usage: The swipe arrow (160 × 48), bottom-right, 32px left of the mark; at the margin on covers, where there is no mark.

tokens.name: lot-size
tokens.usage: One square in the slide counter's strip; 8px apart. One square per slide, the current one filled.

tokens.name: radius-badge
tokens.usage: Layer tags and squares: nearly square corners.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: The CTA button. The maximum for anything that looks clickable.

tokens.name: radius-frame
tokens.usage: Screenshot frames, white cards, navy-deep panels and headshots: the logomark's corner. Never larger, never pill-shaped.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: No shadows, glows or blurs on slides. Separation comes from hairlines and flat grounds.

tokens.name: line-canvas
tokens.usage: Hairlines on the canvas: frame and card borders, eyebrow rules, motif lines, outlined squares. (1px disappears at phone scale.)

tokens.name: stroke-arrow
tokens.usage: The swipe arrow: the icon set's 1.75px on 24px, scaled to the canvas, square caps.

tokens.name: rule-emphasis
tokens.usage: The gold underline under up to 3 words on a paper slide.

tokens.name: line-outline-card
tokens.usage: The outlined card for the belief in Myth vs method: paper-35 on navy, slate on paper, no fill.
